err.sign: Your answer has the right size but the wrong sign. Recheck which direction you chose as positive.
err.k1000: Your answer is off by a factor of 1000. Check a unit prefix: grams vs kilograms, metres vs kilometres, or mA vs A.
err.k100: Your answer is off by a factor of 100. Check a centimetre-to-metre conversion or a percentage.
err.g: Your answer is off by a factor of g (9.8). Check whether you mixed up mass (kg) and weight (N).
err.half: Your answer is off by a factor of 2. Look for a missing ½ (as in ½mv² or ½at²) or a doubled quantity.
err.square: It looks like a square or square root is missing or extra. Check the power on each variable.
err.kmh: Your answer is off by 3.6 — the km/h ↔ m/s conversion. Convert speeds to m/s first.
err.time60: Your answer is off by 60. Check minutes vs seconds (or minutes vs hours).
err.time3600: Your answer is off by 3600. Check hours vs seconds.
err.k1e6: Your answer is off by a factor of a million. Check micro- or mega- prefixes.
err.k1e9: Your answer is off by a factor of a billion. Check nano- or giga- prefixes (e.g. nm to m).
err.invert: Your answer is the reciprocal of the correct one. Check whether a quantity belongs in the numerator or denominator.
err.pi: Your answer is off by a factor of π. Check a circle formula (circumference 2πr, area πr²).
err.twopi: Your answer is off by 2π. Check the conversion between frequency (Hz) and angular frequency (rad/s), or between rev and rad.

diag.method.d: Each of the 20 questions comes from a different unit, in random order. The first question is at Level 2. After a correct answer the next question is harder; after a miss it is easier, with smaller adjustments as evidence builds (a staircase method, not a calibrated IRT model). Missed questions point to their lesson and to the prerequisite sections listed in that lesson. Honors readiness counts only Honors-level items.
